name: OJapp PWA Marketing
author: ojach

sections.description:
OJapp PWA Marketing lets visitors add individual posts, pages, and WooCommerce products directly to their home screen with unique icons.

Instead of turning your entire website into a single PWA, this plugin generates a dedicated manifest.json for each page, making every piece of content installable from its own URL.

Perfect for:

  • Blogs
  • WooCommerce stores
  • Landing pages
  • Documentation
  • Product catalogs

Features

  • Dynamic manifest.json generation
  • start_url set to “.”
  • Automatic home screen icon generation
  • Automatic apple-touch-icon support
  • Custom icon for each post or product
  • WooCommerce compatible
  • Lightweight and no external services
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Open a supported post or page.
  4. Add it to the home screen.
sections.faq:
Does this create a traditional PWA?

No.

This plugin focuses on page-specific home screen experiences instead of creating a single installable application.

Does it support WooCommerce?

Yes.

Products can generate their own manifest and home screen icon automatically.

Does it work without WooCommerce?

Yes.

It supports standard WordPress posts and pages out of the box.
